name: raster-css
description: The International Typographic Design System for Humans and AI Agents. Distinct Swiss Design framework.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['src/css/tokens.css', 'src/css/reset.css', 'src/css/typography.css', 'src/css/grid.css', 'src/css/components.css', 'src/css/utilities.css']; const bundle = files.map(f => fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')).join('\n'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/raster.css', bundle); fs.writeFileSync('docs/raster.css', bundle); fs.copyFileSync('AI.md', 'docs/AI.md'); fs.copyFileSync('llms.txt', 'docs/llms.txt'); console.log('dist/raster.css and docs/ assets built successfully!');"

author: Raster UI Core Team
